A_golden_design_system.rule: GOLDEN FIXED. Copy as-is into a new project; never fork per screen. Changes go back to the Golden Reference.
notes: components.css and interactions.js also carry the four reference pages (01-04); their page sections are reference implementations, not dependencies of the module pages.

r13: router.js (persistent shell over HTTP, docs/PERSISTENT_SHELL.md) is loaded FIRST of the deferred scripts on every shell page (tools/shell_sync.py inserts it); on file:// it stays off. Serve the lab with serve.cmd / tools/serve.py.

r13 phase 5a: docs.js (MCDoc: one paper renderer + MCDoc.totals), guide.js (MCProgress, MCChecks, MCResult, MCNext, MCPrereq) and composer.js (MCComposer, the live document composer) are SHARED runtime, loaded right after patterns.js on every shell page (tools/shell_sync.py inserts them); their CSS lives in patterns.css sections 12, 12b, 12c.

B_project_configuration.rule: PROJECT CONFIGURABLE. One file per project.

files: pages/*.html (content inside [data-page-body]; the shell block comes from the skeleton)

external_backend.rule: EXTERNAL / BACKEND RESPONSIBILITY. Never simulated as real in the template.
items: idempotent command handling (one command id per submission)

tools.tools/shell_sync.py: scaffold a page for a route (--new) and keep the static navigation fallback (r12: the two-level tree for the page's data-route) in step with project-config.js; --check reports stale pages
tools.tools/export_config.js: resolved project configuration as JSON (routes, modules, account; r12: tree, bottomItems, navIndex, current, home per project + role)
tools.tools/route_check.py: registry <-> files <-> links integrity; every navigation entry of both tree levels, bottom item and account entry resolves to a page; a rendered group has >= 2 children; no '#', javascript:, data-placeholder
tools.tools/nav_audit.py: r12 navigation audit per project + role (Owner, Admin, nusantara, longname): route without module/parent, child to a missing route, dead destination, duplicate entries, hidden route shown, role-invalid entry, active-ancestry mismatch, depth > 2, bottom bar; --pages = page-duplication heuristic (page links that repeat a nav entry; audit signal)
tools.tools/clickability.py: no-dead-control rule by behaviour (every control does something observable)
tools.tools/page_check.py: per-page errors, overflow, links and screenshots at desktop / tablet / phone
tools.tools/a11y_check.py: headings, accessible names, labels, alt, contrast and 44 px phone targets on every route
tools.tools/make_app_map.py: review/app-map.html generated from the route registry, with the hierarchy view MODULE -> NAV DESTINATIONS -> DETAIL / TASK routes (per-role marks)
tools.tools/make_owner_review.py: review/owner-review.html: prioritised inspection plan with evidence links
tools.tools/capture_evidence_r10.py: renders the evidence/final/r10 captures listed in the owner review
tools.tools/route_samples.json: sample query parameters for detail routes (tools, app map, tests)
tools.tools/ux_density.py: action density per route: buttons / menus / links above the fold, primary count, competing loud controls (desktop + phone, --role admin); flags button soup
tools.tools/capture_evidence_r11.py: evidence/final/r11: before/after captures of the R11 key screens (desktop 1366, 1920, 1024, phone 390) for review/owner-review.html

tablet.shell: icon rail + full navigation drawer (a rail group icon opens the drawer at its group); account avatar at the rail bottom

desktop.shell: two-level sidebar (collapsible to the icon rail: toggle or Ctrl/Cmd+B) + calm top bar (search / palette); account at the sidebar bottom
desktop.density: runtime units --du/--dt/--tu/--iu at browser zoom 100 %; content max 1680 px

route.title: {id,en} label, never business data
route.parent: the TRUE hierarchical parent route id (breadcrumbs, the navigation's current walk); r12: null on a navigation destination whose siblings are their own entries
route.defaults: r12: { param: value } applied when the address omits the param (addresses compare after defaults)
route.views: r12: { param, titles: { value: {id,en} } } views of one route that the navigation may list as entries (h1 + <title> per view)
route.roles: roles allowed; others get the not-found page
route.shell: false for screens without the app shell

module.label: {id,en}
module.bottomNav: eligible for the phone bottom bar (default true)

routeModuleContract.api: window.MCRoutes { all, get, href, allowed, current, param, trail, modules, module, view } and window.MCProject { navItem, sidebarGroups, bottomKeys, accountMenu, can, role; r12: navTree, navCurrent, bottomItems, navIndex, navProvides, navCovers, home } (docs/NAVIGATION_ARCHITECTURE.md)

interactionPrimitives: navigation (r12: one two-level tree for sidebar, rail and drawer; disclosure groups; one aria-current per landmark; bottom nav per role; breadcrumbs = true ancestors)
command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K) with registry destinations + record providers
risk confirmation (MCRisk: LOW / COMMIT / DESTRUCTIVE / CRITICAL) + double-execution guard
list keyset "Muat Lagi" (r13: numbered lists page with MCPager instead)
route capability guard (MSG-10 forbidden vs not-found)
business date "Tanggal transaksi" (PT-25) on issuing commands
accessibility: keyboard: menus, listbox, tabs, dialogs, sheets, palette
focus trap + return on modal layers
Esc closes overlays (decision dialogs: Esc = cancel)
>= 16 px text inputs on touch devices
no colour-only status (text always carries meaning)
tables with captions and th scope
motion: token durations 80/160/200/240/320/400 ms and named curves (docs/MOTION_SYSTEM.md)
motion explains state change, hierarchy, feedback, continuity only

reduced motion: 150 ms opacity fades, no automatic text movement
